questions.q: What is a 'work area' in Oracle Fusion?
options: A physical office location for the AP team
A dashboard-style landing page built around a role's daily tasks, with infotiles summarizing items needing attention
A spreadsheet used to import invoices
Another name for a purchase order
questions.explain: Work areas are task-oriented landing pages with clickable infotiles, not flat menus.

questions.q: Which work area is the daily home base for entering and resolving problems with invoices?
options: Suppliers
Payments
Invoices
General Ledger
questions.explain: The Invoices work area is where an AP specialist enters, finds, validates, and resolves invoice issues.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the four independent status fields an invoice carries?
options: Invoice status
Approval status
Payment status
Shipping status
questions.explain: The four fields are invoice status, approval status, accounting status, and payment status. There is no 'shipping status' on an invoice.

questions.q: An invoice is Validated, Approved, and Accounted, but its Payment status is Unpaid. What does this most likely mean?
options: The invoice simply hasn't reached its due date yet
The invoice has an unresolved hold
The invoice was rejected during approval
The invoice failed validation
questions.explain: The four statuses move independently. A validated, approved, accounted invoice is often just waiting for its due date before payment.

questions.q: Clicking an infotile on the Invoices work area typically does what?
options: Immediately pays every invoice shown
Deletes the invoices in that category
Drops a filtered table of the matching invoices into the content area below
Opens the Suppliers work area instead
questions.explain: Infotiles are clickable summaries; clicking one filters the content area to show just those invoices.
